messages:
Asha (arch): Quick follow-up on the API-v1 -> v2 migration RFC. Proposal: small "shearline" gateway shim that translates v1 requests to v2, shadow-mode for 2w, opt-in tenant cutovers, then a 90d soft-deprecation window. High level pros/cons below.

Tom C: need to call out p99 latency impact. Any extra hops add tail latency.

Asha (arch): yep — measured target is <1ms added median, p99 <8ms. Will run perf harness on staging GPUs + 95th percentile network. If we see >10% p99 regression we back off.

Luca R: how does this affect KV cache and token-level batching? Shims often disable efficient batching.

Asha (arch): good point. Design note: shim will be a lightweight HTTP layer that only rewrites request shape and headers, avoids touching tokenization/KV path. Requests still route to the same runtime buckets. If tenant uses legacy framing that prevents continuous-batching we emit a compatibility tag and route to a fallback worker pool.

Priya S: telemetry: we need separate metrics: shim_latency_ms, shim_transform_count, shim_degraded_routing_count, and a migration_state tag per tenant. Also count how many requests hit the fallback pool.

Asha (arch): agreed. Add a boolean header X-Shim-Transformed and include migration_state in span tags. We'll add a shim.* prefix to metrics.

Maya J: runbook + comms? Docs + SDK patch is required so customers can opt out. Also notify CS for top 50 tenants first.

Asha (arch): checklist draft:
- implement translation layer for request shape + headers (v1->v2)
- integration tests (unit + e2e)
- perf harness runs (median/p99 targets)
- telemetry + dashboards
- shadow mode for 14d (traffic mirrored, no effect)
- opt-in program (feature flag per-tenant)
- cohort cutovers (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- soft-deprecation notice timeline (90d) + opt-out escape hatch
- final hard-cut plan if needed

Tom C: what about security/authorization differences? v2 enforces stricter scopes. Shim needs to map scopes and log mismatches.

Asha (arch): shim will validate tokens against current auth service, map legacy scopes to v2 scopes via a configurable table, and emit events for unmapped scopes. If mapping not possible return 403 with a clear error code.

Priya S: sample mapping rule in config: 
```
# shim mappings
legacy_to_v2_scopes:
  write: ["responses:create"]
  admin: ["tenant:admin","billing:write"]
```

Luca R: will adapters be implemented as sidecars or central gateway? Sidecar scales with tenant but increases infra. Gateway centralizes but is a single path.

Asha (arch): start with a central, horizontally-scalable gateway service fronting API nodes. If we see hot-tenant pressure we'll offer a tenant-sidecar option for Dedicated/Private customers.

DeployBot: deploy queued: shearline-gateway-v0.1 -> staging (sha: ab12cd)

Maya J: docs note: include curl examples showing header and body translations. Make sure SDKs include a migration helper.

Asha (arch): example v1 -> v2 translation (for backend devs):
```
# v1 request
POST /v1/generate
Headers: X-API-Version: 1
Body: {"prompt": "Translate", "instructions": "short"}

# shim transforms to v2
POST /v2/chat.generate
Headers: X-API-Version: 2, X-Shim-Transformed: true
Body: {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Translate"}], "parameters": {"style": "short"}}
```

Tom C: also add a config flag to bypass transform for latency-sensitive routes. Some customers prefer hard-deprecate instead of shim.

Asha (arch): add allowlist: bypass_transform_for_routes = ["/v1/embeddings"] etc. We'll default off.

Priya S: telemetry retention: keep migration spans for 30d and capture error codes: shim_map_failed, shim_auth_fallback, shim_perf_degraded.

Luca R: ops: need auto-rollback if p99 increases by >20% or error rate >0.5%. How do we signal rollback?

Asha (arch): rollout controller will monitor the shim.* metrics and emit rollback signal to the deployment operator. We'll add a safety-voter (eng-sre + eng-platform) webhook.

Maya J: timeline suggestion: 2w dev + tests, 2w staging shadow, 2w canaries, then begin opt-in emails + 90d notice. Total: ~12 weeks to hard-deprecate start.

Asha (arch): owners: 
- eng-platform: gateway implementation (Tom C)
- eng-runtime: ensure routing is unchanged (Luca R)
- eng-ml: perf harness + quant tests (Priya S)
- docs + CS: comms & SDK helpers (Maya J)

Asha (arch): next actions today: 1) approve config schema, 2) pr for gateway skeleton, 3) perf harness test plan. Will open issues and assign.

Priya S: +1 on metrics names. I can wire dashboards after the PR.

Tom C: I'll pick up the gateway skeleton.

Luca R: will validate KV/batching routing once branch exists.

Asha (arch): thanks all. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll file the migration epic and kick off the sprint card. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: staging deploy succeeded: shearline-gateway-v0.1 -> staging (sha: ab12cd)
